tasks.gr12-social-implications-privacy-ethics-: Topic: Social Implications, Privacy and Ethics. Cover privacy, POPIA-style data protection principles, informed consent, accessibility, the digital divide, plagiarism, intellectual honesty and environmental responsibility. Ask Grade 12 learners to evaluate realistic scenarios and justify ethical recommendations using evidence.
tasks.gr12-cyber-security-emerging-technologie: Topic: Cyber Security and Emerging Technologies. Cover malware, ransomware, patching, backups, authentication, AI, IoT, cloud computing, remote access and the risks and benefits of new technologies. Ask Grade 12 learners to recommend security controls and evaluate the social impact of emerging tools.
tasks.gr12-integrated-solution-development-pat: Topic: Integrated Solution Development and PAT Completion. Cover requirements analysis, UML or structured planning, combining GUI, classes and databases, systematic testing, user documentation and assembling PAT evidence. Ask Grade 12 learners to reason about whole-solution quality, not only isolated code fragments.
tasks.gr12-network-parts-internet-access-t3: Topic: Network Parts and Internet Access. Cover the switch, cables, wireless base station, router and modem, the all-in-one router, fibre, Wi-Fi, 4G and 5G and satellite connections, sharing files and folders with user rights, BitTorrent risks and benefits, online services, and remote access including a VPN. Ask Grade 12 learners to name the part for a job, choose a connection for a situation, or explain a risk.
tasks.gr12-e-communication-security-t3: Topic: E-communication Security. Cover strong passwords, multi-layer verification, encryption and decryption, blockchain, SSL with public and private keys, certificates, and firewalls. Ask Grade 12 learners to say what each does, which key is used for what, or what a firewall can and cannot do.
tasks.gr12-seo-search-t3: Topic: Better Searching and SEO. Cover semantic search, mediated search, search engine optimisation and what helps a page rank, and honest versus dishonest methods (keyword stuffing, hidden text, link farms). Ask Grade 12 learners to define a term, recognise an honest or dishonest method, or tell SEO from advertising.
